info.title: StrideHub Training API
info.description: Single-athlete, self-hosted training API. PUT merges supplied fields. Existing record mutations require expected version. Dates in queries use runner profile timezone. Never retry a 409 by blindly replacing the version.

conditionsTraining.description: Original weather/check-in advice retained when the overall advice requires constraint review.

HabitualSession.description: Unsaved suggestion inferred from explicit running habits; has no persisted id/version. Explicit sessions on that day suppress the habit.

FeedbackFuel.description: Session-level actual fueling summary, separate from timed fuel logs. Unknown quantities are null, never zero by default.

pain.description: null means not reported; false means explicitly no pain.

activityIds.description: Full replacement of linked activity IDs. Each activity can belong to only one session. Empty array unlinks without changing status.

ActualWorkout.description: Sum of imported movement durations and distances, not the time gap between files. Missing linked records invalidate delta. Interval compliance is not inferred from the aggregate.

ApplicableHealth.description: Declared active constraints applicable on the session/profile-local date. Null validFrom has no specified start; reviewOn never expires a constraint.

Today.description: Read-only runner-local today. No synthetic rest day or next-day workout; feedback queue covers today and previous six days. Fetch a chosen session briefing separately so weather failure does not block daily operations.
